import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;
public class LittleClovesVariant1 {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long firstInput = scanner.nextLong();
        long secondInput = scanner.nextLong();

        long n = firstInput;
        long m = secondInput;

        if (n < m) {
            long temp = n;
            n = m;
            m = temp;
        }

        int answer;
        if (m == 1) {
            int[] array = {0, 0, 0, 2, 4, 6};
            answer = array[(int)((n - 1) % 6)] + 6 * ((n - 1) / 6);
        } else if (m == 2) {
            if (n == 2) {
                answer = 0;
            } else if (n == 3 || n == 7) {
                answer = (int) m * (n - 1);
            } else {
                answer = (int) m * (int) n;
            }
        } else {
            answer = (int) (n * m);
            answer -= answer & 1;
        }
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
